reason: The user requests two pending-order modifications on the same order: an item exchange and an address change. Policy states modify_pending_order_items can only be called once and changes status to 'pending (items modified)', after which the order cannot be modified or cancelled anymore — so the address change cannot be performed after the item modification, and order status is not yet known. The requested exchange also requires confirming the exact item and an available cheapest green variant, plus a payment method for any price difference, none of which has been established. These policy constraints make an unsuccessful or only partially fulfilled interaction likely.
